lines: The app is published. At 02:16 UTC the build of `7f68d26e` went live after a fresh security review that blocked nothing and warned of nothing; its own rebuild equals a build made here without the sound in all 17 files asked for. Visibility: Organization. The live address answers 401 without a sign in, so the live pages were not read from here; what was read is the built folder (351 files, "poster: pass · 40 stills and the table agree with the framing"). The review page's films are older cuts; the newest rough draft is Preview 05.

Chain 9 is read whole and on origin main (`c97fc1dd`): the miniatures made in steps, fall's miniature second list, and the coder's mend of open item 251, which is closed (decision 177). tsc exit 0; build exit 0, engine `48c86419ce417ce9`; the whole vitest 63 files passed and 1 skipped, 887 tests passed and 4 skipped; `node tools/miniatures.mjs` pass, every season the same made whole and in steps; counts at high: fall 1,791,317 of 1,800,000 triangles, summer 1,716,044, winter 1,490,555, spring 1,470,770; six draft stills of the other seasons equal, fall's two changed as expected. "FAIL M3 fall-rest: 0.6996 (threshold 0.75, detail.minSharpnessRatio)", base 0.700, miniature 0.804 where main had 0.789: fall still fails its line on the base. "pass M3 summer-rest: 0.8818".

Picture 1, fall at rest after chain 9, approved left and build right. Below the bar: the trunk is brown where the approved is black with glints, the fence is thin stakes, the air has too many specks and too few leaves, the base's vines are thin. The third list went to its builder at 02:12 UTC (line 03:00, push 03:45, limit 04:15).

Picture 2, summer's tree after its sixth pass (`agent/p6-summer-tree` `2cc16c9d`, not merged yet), approved left and build right. The crown is one broad dark dome with gold points on the outlines and the trunk is slimmer; its builder states "pass M3 summer-rest" at 0.8926. At phone size the pair reads as one tree. Below the bar close up: level tiers at the left with sky between, thick straight boughs, a fine speckle where the approved has soft rounded masses. A seventh list follows.

Picture 3, summer's base after its fourth list (`agent/p6-summer-stone` `2663e240`, not merged yet), approved above and build below. The even rings are gone, the relief is broad unequal swirls, the shade is cool and the base dims in the storm as the approved's does; base 1.049 in its line, 229,351 triangles, exactly its limit. Below the bar: the lit left reads as brown stone where the approved is pale cream sand, thin orange brown crease lines, a narrower darker top roll. Its tones rest on a fitted table of light shares that was looked at in one camera only; it does not merge until the other cameras are seen and the table is smoothed.

Picture 4, the change into summer, film frames 1405 to 1415, main above and the take over below (`agent/p6-summer-air` `ecf23c09`, not merged yet): the cover now thins into summer without a step between frames.
Next chains: the glass's limb alone (one line, `08c71e07`), then summer's tree and air together.

Winter's wedge of blur at film frames 30 and 31 has its cause in five lines of the shared blur map (`src/core/materials.ts` 275 to 279); its mender has leave to change them under five conditions, the calibrate hash equal before and after among them; limit 03:20 UTC. The shutter builder's machine came back by itself, so no second builder was started; its mend of the rows of beads is due 04:00 UTC and no frame after it has been seen. The change of season slipped: shakes 1 and 2 by about 03:50 UTC, all four by about 05:45 UTC. Fall's base builder states base 0.722 with black vines, not pushed; it merges only at 0.700 or more and nearer by eye (decision 176). Spring's base push is due 02:50 UTC, the table's petals 03:30 UTC.

14 agents are at work at 02:35 UTC: summer (miniature, air, glass, sand, base), fall (miniature, base, air), spring (base), winter's glints, the change of season, the controls, the shutter, the table's petals. Summer's tree builder waits for its seventh list.

Render counts since the last status. Drawn here by chain 9: two review stills (fall and summer at rest) and eight draft stills at hd. On helper machines: the stills and frames behind pictures 2 to 4, drawn by their builders. No frame of the masters yet.
Sound: 7,420 of 10,000 credits, unchanged, no call planned.
phase 6: 23.76 h used of its 12.00 h box
allowance (after the review): 23.76 h used of 12.00 h allowed
